description: Change the AI context: the about text, design direction, value props, pricing tiers and testimonials that every AI-personalised lead magnet is generated from. Changes apply to generations from then on; lead magnets already sent are not rewritten. Only the fields sent are changed. It holds what the site actually says, so testimonials and prices come from the owner. The AI context belongs to the whole account and is shared by every website on it, so it cannot be changed from a connection limited to one website.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: update_ai_context
title: Update ai context
